description: Does one source state one finding of a review? claim: the finding as a complete statement (subject, intervention, outcome, number), without citations or the review's framing, and only what this source reports. id: one source the review cites for it — paper, drug label (dailymed:…) or trial record (nct:…); added first when missing. The server reads the stored text and asks a decision model; nothing enters your context. verdict: pass (score is the probability) | fail (the full text does not state it; or only the title is stored — reason says so) | unverifiable (only the abstract is stored and does not state it — reason says so) | error (claim refused: under four words, a fragment, carrying citations; add failed; no model; model failure). basis: full_text | abstract | title. glyphs_unresolved: symbols the PDF font lost; above 0 a failed number may be the font. superseded: true when a stored correction replaced the claim's figure.

claim.description: One finding as a complete statement (subject, intervention, outcome, number), built from the review's words, without its citations and framing.

id.description: ID as "type:value": a paper "pmid:30955454" (bare digits count as pmid) or "doi:10.5812/asjsm.110753" (a paper PubMed does not index; a DOI PubMed indexes is taken as its PMID), a drug label "dailymed:<set ID>" (the set ID from its DailyMed page URL), or a trial record "nct:05173896" (the eight digits; nct:NCT05173896 and a bare NCT05173896 are accepted).

name: library_verify
